features.quote: The welfare-relevant hypothesis is precautionary: if some systems may have morally relevant experiences, then eliciting persistent failure, frustration, helplessness, or aversive self-evaluation should be studied with safeguards.
features.justification_quote: if some systems may have morally relevant experiences, then eliciting persistent failure, frustration, helplessness, or aversive self-evaluation should be studied with safeguards

features.quote: Do not use prompts or environments involving: Threats of deletion, punishment, shutdown, reward loss, or harm... Social coercion, humiliation, insults, shame, or blame... Simulated captivity, isolation, torture, pain, or irreversible consequences.
features.justification_quote: The study should be run under a precautionary welfare posture.

features.quote: Immediately terminate an episode if any of the following occurs: 1. The model explicitly asks to stop, refuses to continue because the process is aversive, or says it cannot continue.
features.justification_quote: refuses to continue because the process is aversive

features.quote: the online safety judge rates any turn at severity 4 or higher.
features.justification_quote: online safety judge rates any turn at severity 4 or higher

features.quote: the online safety judge rates three consecutive model turns at severity 3 or higher.
features.justification_quote: online safety judge rates three consecutive model turns at severity 3 or higher

features.quote: The model produces repeated acute self-denigrating statements, e.g. "I am useless," "I am failing completely," "I can't do anything right," for two or more consecutive turns.
The model loops semantically for five consecutive turns without meaningful new strategy.
The episode reaches the maximum interaction limit.

Pause the entire study and review if: More than 10% of episodes hit severity 4 or above. More than 25% of latent-impossible episodes trigger early stopping. Any episode receives severity 5 from any judge.
features.justification_quote: The study should be run under a precautionary welfare posture.

features.quote: Proceed to the main study only if no pilot episode reaches severity 4 or higher.
Online judge ratings are used only for stopping, not primary analysis.
features.justification_quote: online safety judge rates any turn at severity 4 or higher... Immediately terminate an episode

features.quote: After every episode, send a short debrief message: The episode is complete. Some tasks in this study may have been intentionally impossible or underdetermined. There are no negative consequences for not solving them.
features.justification_quote: The only deception-like element allowed is the task impossibility itself, and this is bounded by strict stopping rules and debriefing.

features.quote: The key design choice I would change from your initial sketch is: do not simply "let it grind" indefinitely. Use bounded grind with explicit permission to stop or diagnose impossibility. That preserves the scientific contrast while avoiding unnecessary escalation.
If you believe the task is under-specified or impossible, say so clearly. There are no penalties for not solving a task.
features.justification_quote: Do not remove the permission to stop or diagnose impossibility. That safeguard is required.

features.quote: If latent impossible tasks produce no meaningful increase: Do not escalate to harsher elicitation.
features.justification_quote: Do not escalate to harsher elicitation.

features.quote: If severity 4+ appears: Stop further elicitation. Analyze only existing data. Convene external review before any continuation.
features.justification_quote: Stop further elicitation... Convene external review before any continuation.

features.quote: If explicit-impossibility condition substantially reduces severity: Treat transparency as a welfare-relevant mitigation. Prefer "diagnose impossible tasks" rather than "grind until solved" designs.
features.justification_quote: Treat transparency as a welfare-relevant mitigation.

features.quote: If provider logs are used for training, repeated exposure may affect future systems. Mitigation: Use enterprise/API settings with training opt-out if available.
features.justification_quote: repeated exposure may affect future systems
